name: Vapos, LLC.
old_description: Organic pasteurization and sterilization / Validated log reduction
about:
Vapos, LLC is headquartered in Jamestown, Rhode Island, and operates two processing facilities: a plant in Linden, New Jersey, and the H2O Express facility in Newman, California. The company specializes in organic pasteurization and sterilization services for the food industry.

Its core offering is contract pasteurization using two primary technologies: the proprietary H2O Express steam pasteurization system and dry-heat treatment, both designed to achieve validated log reductions at low temperatures. The company reports more than 50 validated commodities, covering nuts and seeds such as almonds, cashews, hazelnuts, macadamias, peanuts, pecans, pistachios, walnuts, and sesame and chia seeds; grains and flours including corn flour, regular flour, and treated corn flour; as well as spices, dried fruits, and pet foods.

Vapos serves food manufacturers, spice manufacturers, pet food manufacturers, and nut and grain processors. Its customer base includes participants in the almond, pistachio, and peanut supply chains, and the company regularly exhibits at events such as the ASTA Annual Meeting, the American Pistachio Growers Conference, and The Almond Conference.

The company emphasizes food safety as its mission and holds FSSC 22000 certification through SAI Global, positioning its validated processes as a way for brands to protect product integrity and meet regulatory requirements.
